title: Cloudflare Global Outage From WAF Regular Expression CPU Exhaustion
summary: A new Web Application Firewall managed rule containing a regular expression with excessive backtracking was deployed globally. It exhausted CPU on machines handling HTTP traffic and produced 502 errors worldwide until the WAF was disabled with a global kill.
impact: Cloudflare-proxied sites returned 502 errors worldwide for roughly half an hour.

timeline.description: The new WAF rule is deployed globally and CPU usage spikes on edge machines.
A global kill of the WAF managed rulesets is decided and executed.

causal_factors.description: A regular expression with excessive backtracking consumed CPU on every request path that evaluated it.
The rule change was released worldwide at once without a gradual, canaried rollout.

lessons.statement: Rule and configuration changes deserve the same staged rollout and resource limits as code changes.
lessons.recommended_control: Stage rule releases and use regex engines with bounded execution time.
